text: {"lessons":["After buying four stocks, my account rose sharply and then gave back much of the gain; I should plan for drawdowns and avoid treating temporary gains as guaranteed progress toward a home.","A few trades and monthly account changes do not show whether my choices were good; I should review decisions against a consistent plan rather than judge them by the next month's result.","Before buying, I should check how much cash will remain and whether each holding still fits my goals and risk tolerance, so I can respond thoughtfully if prices fall."]}
